name: 캐시
visual_review: 갈색 긴 머리·푸른 눈·흰 의사 코트와 톱을 유지했습니다. 톱 준비와 회전 휘두름·앞으로 낮게 진입·수술 회복 구역·무기 회수 단계가 읽힙니다.
motion_summary: Cathy brown long hair and blue eyes, white doctor coat over dark-blue outfit and surgical saw/scalpel exactly from identity. Official R sweeps a saw while rapidly advancing, leaving a healing strip. Animate composed idle; hands firm on surgical tool; raise saw diagonally behind shoulder; lower knees; accelerate forward; broad saw sweep horizontally right with silver-cyan arc; full forward lunge with trailing white coat; finish sweeping through with pale blue-white surgical trail low behind; green-cyan tiny healing sparkles in that trailing strip; pivot and tool draw-back; coat settles; original idle. No gore, no red blood, no hospital scenery, no generic healing staff. Precise clinical focused eyes, small mouth visible. True moving saw/arms/body sequence, not a teleport or stationary aura.
